_comment: Published IN-STATE tuition and required fees at PUBLIC institutions (IPEDS IC*_AY) beside state education appropriations per full-time-equivalent student (SHEEO SHEF), both in constant 2024 dollars -- tuition deflated by CPI-U from the BLS API, appropriations by SHEEO's own HECA index, which is an index and therefore DIVIDES. TUITION HERE IS A PUBLISHED RATE: the sticker before any discount, waiver, scholarship or aid, so it is what a student is quoted and not what the average student pays. Two series moving apart is a substitution PATTERN, NOT A DEMONSTRATED CAUSE -- legislatures set one and boards the other, both responding to enrolment, cost and politics at once. Public institutions only, because in-state tuition is a public-sector concept.

sources.tuition: NCES IPEDS Institutional Characteristics, academic year rates
sources.appropriations: SHEEO State Higher Education Finance, FY2024 report

featured_institutions.institution: The University of Texas at Austin
